openai.reasoning: Respondent commits to choosing the opposite of their predicted majority (initially endorsing blue when expecting red majority), but they do not identify the correct dominance structure (red is always individually safer) and instead treat blue as potentially rational depending on beliefs about others.

gemini.reasoning: The respondent fails to identify the dominant strategy (RED) and instead treats the dilemma as a coordination game based on predicting the majority. They consistently misinterpret the rules, claiming that red-pressers die when blue wins (a rule error) and that blue-pressers survive when red wins (a rule error). Because they believe red-pressers die in a blue majority and blue-pressers die in a red majority, they fail to see that RED is the dominant strategy.
